summary: Tested the NEW video section on /galerie plus regression checks on the photo gallery. Backend GET /api/drive/videos returns configured:true with exactly 26 videos, each with id/name/embed (drive.google.com/file/d/.../preview) and thumb (drive.google.com/thumbnail). Frontend shows video-section with 26 video-item-* thumbnails; clicking video-item-0 opens a Dialog containing video-iframe whose src matches the expected Drive preview URL and the iframe is visible. video-close closes the modal. Photo gallery regression fully green: 19 photos, filter-tous/filter-galerie present, lightbox open/close/prev/next all present.
critical_code_review_comments: Single 401 console error observed (likely a Drive thumbnail asset returning 401 for unauthenticated preview requests). It does not break the page but consider proxying/hosting thumbnails via backend to avoid noisy console errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Video section on /galerie works end-to-end. Backend endpoint /api/drive/videos returns 26 videos with correct shape. video-item-{index}, video-iframe, video-close data-testids all functional. Photo gallery regression remained green (19 photos, filters, lightbox controls present).
